text:
incident-bot: CRITICAL: quality-regression signal for tenant GlobexCorp (tenant_id: gxb-431) on dedicated pool dp-eu-2. Signal: rerank_precision_down (-22%) after quant-profile q6_384_alpha enabled at 2026-03-15T22:07:00Z.

Priya Shah: paging @Mira and @Sam. is this isolated to Globex?

Mira Nguyen: investigating. early read shows the request sampling for gxb-431 (finetuned L2 variant) has larger token logits variance. Our canary eval shows rerank precision drop from 0.78 -> 0.61. Other tenants on dp-eu-2 currently on q4_128_stable.

Sam Carter: important: Globex is on a VPC-dedicated pool and requested q6_384_alpha last week for latency-cost tradeoff. Confirm whether rollout was tenant-specific or pool-default.

infra-bot: rollout-log: q6_384_alpha applied as "pool-default" for dp-eu-2 at 22:07:00Z due to automation rule 'aggressive-compression-apply' matching pool tags. Affected tenants: gxb-431 (pinned=false), new_override_count=0.

Mira Nguyen: oh — automation accidentally flipped. That explains multi-tenant exposure risk. Need fast revert for Globex and pool-level rollback. First step: set per-tenant override to q4_128_stable for gxb-431 while we rollback pool default.

Sam Carter: agree. Priya, Ana, set expectations with customer: we'll revert and validate, ETA 20m.

Ana Ruiz (CS): messaging Globex now: "We're investigating an anomalous quality regression tied to a quantization profile change. We'll run a targeted revert and validate, expect update in ~20m." asked if they want query logs replayed.

Mira Nguyen: prepping revert command. We'll do canary 10% then 100% for tenant, then pool rollback. Command (ops):

```bash
rwctl tenant override set --tenant gxb-431 --pool dp-eu-2 --quant q4_128_stable --canary 10 --note "emergency revert: quality regression"
```

Priya Shah: ops, run it. also trigger pool rollback ticket.

deploy-bot: queued tenant-override/gxb-431 -> executing on dp-eu-2 slot 2

infra-bot: opening rollback PR to ops repo: rollback-default-q6_384_alpha in progress (auto-approval bypassed).

Mira Nguyen: snapshot before revert:
```
metric rerank_precision (mean)
- baseline (pre-change): 0.78
- current (q6_384_alpha): 0.61
metric answer_consistency
- baseline: 0.91
- current: 0.74
p95 latency: +3ms (negligible)
```

deploy-bot: tenant-override/gxb-431 canary 10% active at 22:12:40Z

Mira Nguyen: canary metrics (5m): rerank_precision -> 0.77, answer_consistency -> 0.90. Good signal.

Sam Carter: promote to 100% for tenant once you verify no infra churn. Priya, confirm customer comms updated to "mitigating now".

Priya Shah: update sent: "We've initiated a targeted revert; initial canary shows positive recovery. We'll confirm full fix in ~5-10m."

deploy-bot: promoting tenant-override/gxb-431 -> 100% (22:15:05Z).

Mira Nguyen: full-traffic check: rerank_precision=0.79, answer_consistency=0.92. Mitigation for Globex complete.

Sam Carter: next: pool-default rollback to avoid other tenants getting the bad profile. infra to apply rollback PR.

infra-bot: rollback PR merged, starting pool-default revert for dp-eu-2 to q4_128_stable. This will be a metadata default change; runtime model instances will not restart.

Mira Nguyen: monitoring other tenants on dp-eu-2: no regressions observed post-rollback.

Priya Shah: Ana, please offer Globex follow-up: 1) RCA + patch ETA 2) offer to replay subset of logs for their QA 3) schedule customer RCA meeting.

Ana Ruiz (CS): noted. Sending proposed times. They asked for a written summary; I'll attach timeline and metrics.

Mira Nguyen: preliminary root cause: q6_384_alpha used an experimental per-layer scale compression that under certain distributional shifts (Globex's long-fin context) causes attention quantization bias. Only apparent on finetuned variants with narrow token embedding ranges. Action items:
- quarantine q6_384_alpha from auto-rollout pool rules
- create regression harness with Globex prompt set + heavy-context inputs
- patch dequant scaling in alpha profile and unit test across 3 finetune seeds
- ensure automation requires explicit tenant opt-in for experimental profiles

Sam Carter: Priya, can you coordinate with Policy team to disable 'aggressive-compression-apply' until checks are added?

Priya Shah: will file POL-4821 to block auto-apply and cc infra.

infra-bot: profile q6_384_alpha flagged/disabled in model-catalog.

deploy-bot: created follow-up ticket INC-2490001234-PATCH for kernel/quant fixes and regression harness.

incident-bot: STATUS: mitigated; customer_impacted=true; tenants_affected=["gxb-431"]; started=2490001234; resolved=2490001278

Sam Carter: handing off monitoring to night oncall Mira (overnight). Please escalate if any odd signal. I'll draft incident note + add links to tickets.

Mira Nguyen: ack. will keep eyeballs on rerank_precision and answer_consistency for 2 hours.

Ana Ruiz (CS): Globex replied: "Thanks for the quick response. We'll wait for the RCA and please include whether this can be auto-applied elsewhere." I've scheduled the customer call for next Wednesday.

Priya Shah: good job team. We'll keep incident open for follow-up until patch lands. Closing active page.

Sam Carter: closing thread for active paging; leave alerts enabled. Follow-up tickets: INC-2490001234-PATCH, POL-4821.
